method: Recovered original checkpoint and publication archives. Catalogue opened SQLite mode=ro. Existing provenance verifier compared source coordinates, nodes and modes. No catalogue build, repair, publication or writes.

fresh_checks.android_tests: Not rerun; historical 810-test result linked from integrated baseline. No device testing performed.

mileposts.geographic_region_counts: Not independently spatially verified; no approved 12-geography matrix
mileposts.status: Historical candidate evidence only. No coordinates copied into active data.
